content:
The [Salary Conversion Calculator](/salary-conversion-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Convert pay between hourly, weekly, monthly and annual — with your hours per week. Enter your pay amount, this amount is and hours worked per week and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Convert a salary between hourly, weekly, monthly and annual pay in one step. Enter what you earn and how often, plus the hours you work each week, and see the same pay expressed every other way — the conversion assumes 52 working weeks a year and uses your own hours-per-week figure, so a 35-hour week and a 45-hour week give different hourly rates for the same annual salary. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Salary Conversion Calculator

Start by entering your pay amount, then choosing your this amount is from the list and finally entering your hours worked per week. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause.

1. Enter the pay amount you know.
2. Say whether that amount is hourly, weekly, monthly or annual.
3. Enter your usual hours per week — it changes the hourly rate.
4. Read the same pay expressed as hourly, weekly, monthly and annual.

## Formula

Annual = hourly × hours per week × 52; weekly = annual ÷ 52; monthly = annual ÷ 12; hourly = annual ÷ (hours per week × 52).

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Salary Conversion Calculator](/salary-conversion-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. A $65,000 annual salary at 40 hours a week is $31.25 an hour, $1,250 a week and $5,416.67 a month. The same $65,000 at 35 hours a week is $35.71 an hour. Try the same figures in the [Salary Conversion Calculator](/salary-conversion-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Pay amount: 65000, This amount is: Annual, Hours worked per week: 40), the [Salary Conversion Calculator](/salary-conversion-calculator) returns Hourly rate: $31.25, Weekly pay: $1,250, Monthly pay: $5,416.67, Annual salary: $65,000, Based on: 40 hours/week, 52 weeks/year. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Loan Calculator](/loan-calculator) is worth a look before you finish.

## Why hours per week matter

An annual salary only becomes an hourly rate once you know the hours. $65,000 a year is $31.25 an hour at 40 hours a week, but $35.71 at 35 hours and $27.78 at 45 hours. Two jobs with the same salary can pay very different hourly rates, which is why this converter asks for your hours instead of assuming them.

## What the conversion leaves out

These are gross figures before tax, and the converter assumes you are paid for 52 weeks a year — it does not deduct unpaid leave, and it does not include overtime, bonuses, tips or benefits. For what actually lands in your bank account, use the paycheck calculator, which estimates tax and deductions.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Compare job offers on the hourly rate, not the headline salary — it is the only figure that accounts for the hours.
- If your hours vary, use your average week over the last month.
- A 4-day week at the same salary is a pay rise per hour — check it here.

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I convert an annual salary to an hourly rate?

Divide the annual salary by the number of hours you work in a year: hours per week × 52. $65,000 at 40 hours a week is $65,000 ÷ 2,080 = $31.25 an hour. Try it with your own numbers in the [Salary Conversion Calculator](/salary-conversion-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### How many hours a year is a full-time job?

At 40 hours a week for 52 weeks it is 2,080 hours. This calculator uses your own hours per week rather than assuming 40, so part-time and overtime schedules convert correctly. Try it with your own numbers in the [Salary Conversion Calculator](/salary-conversion-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Is monthly pay just annual pay divided by 12?

Yes — monthly pay is annual ÷ 12. Weekly pay is annual ÷ 52, which is slightly different from monthly ÷ 4, because a month is a little longer than 4 weeks.
